collate_tokens: create a padded 2d tensor from a list of 1d tensors with configurable padding and EOS handling
load_indexed_dataset: load an indexed dataset from a file path with optional dictionary and combined dataset support
post_process: post process a tokenized sentence by removing subword markers like sentencepiece or wordpiece symbols
compute_mask_indices: compute random mask spans for a given shape with configurable mask probability length and type
batch_by_size: yield mini-batches of indices bucketed by size with max tokens and sentences constraints
